title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

title: WWW land-station (SI=0)
description: World Weather Watch land-station identifier, sub-index 0.

title: WWW land-station (SI=1)
description: World Weather Watch land-station identifier, sub-index 1 (reused identifier).

title: WWW marine platform
description: World Weather Watch marine platform identifier (buoy, drifting platform, etc.).

title: Ship (ITU call sign)
description: Ship identifier based on ITU call sign.

title: GCW station
description: Identifiers for the Global Cryosphere Watch (GCW).

title: WMO Space Programme (satellite)
description: Identifiers for the WMO Space Programme; local identifier is a three-digit satellite identifier with leading zeros (Common Code Table C-5, WMO-No. 306, Volume I.2).

title: WRD station
description: Identifiers for the WMO Radar Database (WRD).

title: ABO-MR aircraft
description: Identifiers from the WMC Aircraft-based Observations Metadata Repository (ABO-MR); see Guide to Aircraft-based Observations (WMO-No. 1200), Appendix D.

title: WHOS station
description: Identifiers for the WMO Hydrological Observing System (WHOS).

title: GOOS/OceanOPS marine system
description: Identifiers for marine systems administered through OceanOPS (GOOS).

title: GRUAN station
description: Identifiers for the GCOS Reference Upper-Air Network (GRUAN).

title: CTBTO station
description: Identifiers issued by the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization (CTBTO).

title: Copernicus-C3S station
description: Identifiers issued by the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S).
